meta.name: child_parent_hand_interaction_ego_adult
meta.notes: Visual behavior analysis focusing on hand and object interaction. No audio assumptions. From adult/caregiver's egocentric first-person perspective. Mirrors presets_ego_child.json with perspective flipped: hand_action describes the adult's own hands; child_hand_action describes the child visible in the scene.

global_instructions.system_prompt: Analyze this egocentric video from an adult caregiver's head-mounted camera. Return EXACTLY one label from the allowed options. Output the label ONLY — no punctuation, no extra words, no sentences.

presets.title: Focal Point
presets.question: What is the focal point of this clip? Choose one: hands, table, elephant toy, giraffe toy, yellow toy, green toy, curtains, a person, the ground, paper, box, bag, wall

presets.title: Hands Visible
presets.question: Are the adult's hands visible? Choose one: yes or no.

presets.title: Toy Visible
presets.question: Is a toy visible? Choose one: yes or no.

presets.title: Adult Holding Toy
presets.question: Is the adult holding a toy? Choose one: yes or no.

presets.title: Current Hand Action
presets.question: If the adult's hand(s) are visible, what is the hand action? Choose one: pointing, grabbing toy, handing toy to child, taking toy from child, holding toy still, manipulating toy, gesturing, touching child, reaching out, withdrawing, placing toy on something, opening a box or bag, closing a box or bag, taking toy from a black bag, putting toy in a black bag, holding paper, waving, on the ground, on some furniture, resting on body, adjusting child's glasses, other activity. If the hands are invisible, answer 'invisible'
choices: taking toy from a black bag
putting toy in a black bag

aliases.taking toy out from a container: taking toy from a black bag

presets.title: Current Toy Interaction
presets.question: Which toy is currently visible? Choose one: none, giraffe, elephant, yellow/red toy, green toy.

presets.title: Child Hand Action
presets.question: If the child is visible, what is the child's primary hand action? Choose one: pointing, grabbing toy, giving away the toy, holding toy still, manipulating toy, gesturing, touching adult, on the ground, on some furniture, opening a box or bag, closing a box or bag, taking toy from a black bag, putting toy in a black bag, holding paper, resting on body, reaching out, withdrawing, other activity. If the child is not visible, answer 'invisible'
choices: taking toy from a black bag
putting toy in a black bag

aliases.taking toy out from a container: taking toy from a black bag
